Hanno Eco-Tourism Association

Explore how forests nurture wood, and how wood and traditional craftsmanship come together to build homes that showcase the beauty of wood to its fullest.

【Fee】Adults ¥4,000 | Elementary school children and under ¥1,000 (includes guide, lunch, and insurance)

【Capacity】20 people

【Guide】Yasuo Komine (Komine Lumber)

【What to bring】Water bottle, towel, work gloves, clothes and shoes suitable for hiking
location: 集合 西武池袋線「東吾野駅」駅前広場
summary: 木の家探訪〜森から家へ〜第１回「森林と林業」
